name: codex-gears
description: High-class ZDH gear routing pack for shareable local-first policy and route selection.

interface.shortDescription: Portable routing policy package for local-first Codex gear selection and local-only execution discipline.
interface.longDescription: This plugin adds a compact but complete routing policy package: conflict-aware gear selection, local-only execution safeguards, and deterministic provider override behavior. It is intended to be copyable and installable in other workspaces or teams with no local policy drift.
defaultPrompt: Apply ZDH Gears for consistent local/remote routing decisions and local-only handling.
